subtitles.en: Joining us now is Amina Rosenberg as a co-founder and portfolio manager at Minatole Capital.
subtitles.zh: 现在加入我们的是Minatole Capital的联合创始人兼**组合经理Amina Rosenberg。

subtitles.en: Amina, really great to have you with us and so we finally come to this point and of course even though the sort of risk event clearance has already happened with the first day of trading,
subtitles.zh: Amina，非常高兴你能来。我们终于到了这个节点，当然尽管首日交易的风险事件已经过去，

subtitles.en: a lot can still happen in the next sort of week or so as we saw with the SpaceX price action.
subtitles.zh: 接下来一周左右仍可能发生很多事，就像我们在SpaceX的价格走势中看到的那样。

subtitles.en: What are your expectations here particularly as we see this kind of dislocation between the high degree of enthusiasm for Anthropic versus what we're seeing in the rest of the market?
subtitles.zh: 你对这里有什么预期，特别是当我们看到对Anthropic的高度热情与市场其他部分之间出现这种脱节时？

subtitles.en: Yeah I think one of the risks is like does it suck a lot of capital into Anthropic?
subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为风险之一在于它是否会把大量资金吸引到Anthropic。

subtitles.en: I have a little bit in two minds about that like on one hand you know around a hundred billion is a lot of money in one go and some of it will have come from selling other tech names.
subtitles.zh: 我对此有点矛盾。一方面，你知道，大约一千亿美元一次性投入是很多钱，其中一部分可能来自出售其他科技股。

subtitles.en: We obviously saw that on day one with the Nasdaq and Nvidia actually up at finishing down so it's fair to say there's probably been some shifting of capital into Anthropic and until now investors
subtitles.zh: 我们显然在第一天看到纳斯达克和英伟达实际上从上涨转为收跌，所以可以说可能有一些资金转移到了Anthropic，而直到现在市场参与者

subtitles.en: have used Nvidia and the memory stocks as proxies or stand-ins for the labs and now they can own a lab directly but on the other you know there was a lot of enthusiasm the book was seven times covered
subtitles.zh: 一直将英伟达和存储类权益资产作为实验室的代理或替代品，现在他们可以直接拥有一家实验室。但另一方面，你知道，市场热情很高，认购倍数达到七倍，

subtitles.en: so plenty of money missed out it's still still sitting in the market and the cash doesn't really stay at Anthropic right like most of it should go back out to Google Amazon Nvidia and Broadcomers
subtitles.zh: 所以大量资金错过了，这些钱仍留在市场中，而现金并不会真正留在Anthropic，大部分应该会回流到谷歌、亚马逊、英伟达和博通等公司的

subtitles.en: compute spend so you should view it more like recycling than a black hole and honestly I'd rather see this build out funded with equity than with more debt so you know you can see a bit of it on day one
subtitles.zh: 计算支出中。所以你应该更多将其视为资金循环而非黑洞。老实说，我更希望这种建设由股权而非更多债务来融资，所以你知道，第一天就能看到一些迹象。

subtitles.en: with investors reportedly selling AMD and Nvidia to buy Anthropic it's worth watching as morst.com's
subtitles.zh: 据报道，市场参与者卖出AMD和英伟达，转而配置Anthropic，这值得关注，正如morst.com的
